decisions.statement: The tree this script builds is the one rsynced to the machine this script runs on.
Which app this script is building is read from the arguments this script was handed.
A site is looked for after the app's own add or sync rather than before.
The manifest the install reads is written at the root of the delivered tree.
The install runs at that root rather than in the shell folder.
No folder of the delivered tree but its root carries a manifest.
The script making an app's native sources is run by name rather than by a manifest.
A build with no widget extension is refused rather than installed.

definition: what builds one app for a simulator and installs it there
